item.tib: gtad bkrol gyi man ngag yig chung
item.coloph: tsi rta dkrug pa'i 'khrul 'khor shi sa bstan pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'di/ kho bo li shu stag ring gis/ rna rgyan byas nas bod la brgyud/ rje rgyal btsan po'i (pos) gter la sbas/ las kyi gshen sgur bdag gis thon/ zhu byas gnyid la dam du gtam/ de nas rim gyis brgyud pa'o/ gzhon gang nas bla ma'i phyogs su brgyud/ yig chung lho gter nas rin chen rgyal mtshan gyi thon pa bdag gis zhus snyo//
